parsedVerdict.reasoning: TaskManagementService does what an application-layer use-case service should do. It coordinates repositories and the ID generator through domain-defined interfaces. It checks that the referenced project and assignee exist, turns input DTOs into domain entities, hands state changes to the entities (task.markDone()), saves them through repository interfaces, and maps entities back to DTOs. It has no persistence code (no SQL, ORM or file I/O), no transport or framework code (no HTTP request/response handling, status codes or routing), and no presentation logic. Converting the dueDate ISO string into a Date and rejecting invalid dates is input handling at the application boundary, not a domain invariant. Business rules such as completing a task stay in the domain entity. No ADR prose was provided to check against.
